verdict.rationale: Canny lets PMs track idea/roadmap statuses (e.g. via MCP: 'Update statuses, link deals, organize requests') and query the roadmap, but there's no evidence of granular task-level tracking that shows what a task is 'blocked on' or a true real-time last-updated feed. missing for 10: evidence of blocker/dependency tracking, real-time status change notifications, and per-task last-update timestamps beyond generic roadmap status.
